issue.title: test_jump_all_modal_ctrl_u_scrolls_up_without_dismissing fails under the full parallel lane, passes on isolated rerun
issue.description:
## Flake report

- **Test:** `tests/ace/tui/test_jump_all_modal_hints.py::test_jump_all_modal_ctrl_u_scrolls_up_without_dismissing`
- **Repro:** `just check` (escalated to the full parallel lane)

PROPOSED BY phase bead sase-qt.4 (epic sase-qt, "ACE Memory panel for browsing
and editing SASE memory notes"), routed here by that epic's land agent.

OBSERVED: the node failed once inside a full-suite `just check` run on
2026-08-19 (34045 passed in that run) and passed when rerun individually on the
same tree. The phase's diff added the Memory panel shell
(`src/sase/ace/tui/modals/memory_panel*.py`), a TCSS block, and the modal export
table entry; it does not touch the JumpAll modal, its hints, or `ctrl+u`
scrolling, so the phase did not cause this.

NOT YET CORROBORATED: single sighting from one workspace. The node is NOT in
`tests/reproducible_flake_baseline.txt`, so `tools/selection_health
--fail-on-new-flake` will treat a second sighting as a new flake and turn
`check-full` red. Confirm it reproduces before chasing a mechanism, and per that
file's header add a baseline entry naming this bead only once there is real
repeat evidence.

LIKELY SHAPE: this is a Textual modal key-handling assertion, the same family as
several already-tracked parallel-lane flakes where a modal's async settle does
not complete under load -- compare sase-og (a fixed `pause(0.25)` read of an
async verdict in `test_snippet_name_modal.py`), sase-pe
(`test_enter_loads_raw_definition_and_binds_source`, NoMatches on a widget that
had not mounted yet), and sase-qm. If the test settles the modal with a fixed
`pause()` rather than a bounded wait for the scroll offset to change, the fix is
the same bounded-wait shape those beads describe.

SCOPE: confirm the failure mode from a real reproduction (the original run's
traceback was not captured), then either make the test wait deterministically on
the scroll offset or fix the modal path that drops the `ctrl+u` under load.

task_type_fields.evidence: Failed once during a full-suite `just check` run on 2026-08-19 (34045 passed in that run) at epic sase-qt phase 4, then passed on an isolated rerun of the same tree. Fail rate 1/2 observed; parallel-lane only, not reproduced serially. Confirmed still passing serially at HEAD a67ba351f. Single workspace, single head. Not present in tests/reproducible_flake_baseline.txt, so a second sighting will trip tools/selection_health --fail-on-new-flake.

payload.entry: RELATED: sase-og — a Textual modal test whose fixed pause(0.25) read of an async verdict fails under a loaded lane; if this node settles the modal the same way, one bounded-wait fix retires both.
RELATED: sase-pe — tests/ace/tui modal test that fails under the full parallel lane on a widget that had not mounted yet; same lane, same modal-settle family.

payload.close_reason: Fixed by b8559f36f 'fix(ace): stabilize async teardown and interaction waits' (2026-08-21): tests/ace/tui/test_jump_all_modal_hints.py replaced its bare `await pilot.pause()` calls with semantic waits on the exact scroll position (wait_for(pilot, lambda: scroll.scroll_y == visible_height // 2) and the ctrl+u counterpart), so the assertion no longer races a fixed settle window. Verified 2026-08-24 at 45806495f.
